ADC_ADMIN

Main package to administer ADC metadata.  Legacy wrapper methods for exported movement-data scripts remain for backward compatibility.

Author

Juergen Sieben, ConDeS GmbH

Constants
Public Constants
C_ALL_GROUPS

Export all ADC groups

C_APEX_APP

Export all ADC groups of an APEX application including the application itself

C_APP_GROUPS

Export all ADC group of an APEX application

C_PAGE_GROUP

Export a single ADC group

C_EXPORT_USER

Export all user defined action types

C_EXPORT_SYSTEM

Export all ADC defined action types

C_EXPORT_ALL

Export ADC and user defined action types

Method to add translated data.  Is used to add translated names and descriptions for existing entries in the tables of ADC

Parameters
p_table_shortcut
in adc_util.ora_name_type

Prefix that is used in the respective table. Will prefix the translated PTI_ID

in adc_util.ora_name_type

Name of the item for which a translation needs to be added

p_pmg_name

Name of the language. One of the Oracle supported language names

p_name
in pit_translatable_item_v.pti_name%type

Translation for names

p_display_name
in pit_translatable_item_v.pti_display_name%type

Translation for display names

p_description
in pit_translatable_item_v.pti_description%type

Translation for descriptions and help texts

in adc_action_param_types_v.capt_display_name%type

p_capt_description
in adc_action_param_types_v.capt_description%type

Optional description

p_capt_capvt_id
in adc_action_param_types_v.capt_capvt_id%type

Reference to ADC_ACTION_PARAM_VISUAL_TYPES, controls how the parameter is displayed visually.

If set to SELECT_LIST or STATIC_LIST, a view of name ADC_PARAM_LOV_<CAPT_ID> must be provided to calculate the available values. This list may be filtered using CRG_ID.

in adc_action_param_types_v.capt_select_list_query%type

p_capt_sort_seq
in adc_action_param_types_v.capt_sort_seq%type

in adc_action_param_types_v.capt_active%type

Optional flag to indicate whether this action type allow recursive calls of rules. Defaults to adc_util.C_TRUE.

p_cat_active]

Optional flag to indicate whether this action type is actually used. Defaults to adc_util.C_TRUE.

export_action_types
function export_action_types(
p_mode 
in varchar2
)
return blob

Method to export an action type. Creates a BLOB instance with the requested action types for export.

Parameter
p_mode
in varchar2

Controls, which ADC rules to export:

  • C_EXPORT_USER: User defined action types

  • C_EXPORT_SYSTEM: Internally defined action types

  • C_EXPORT_ALL: Both, internally and user defined action types
